range.remark: Pss 72-76 (end of Book II, start of Book III). Ps 77 begins pdf 75.

entries.note: LXX and Pesch.: leg. לעמך 'Frieden Deinem Volke'.
בצדקה is striking, since simply צדקה would have to stand; he reads a word meaning abundance of blessing (his translation: 'die Höhen Fülle des Heils'), a letter having dropped out.
entries.flag: proposed form garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: Difficult, and doubtful whether the object is God or the king; LXX had a wholly different reading (καὶ συμπαραμενεῖ). Vielleicht leg. ייראוהו — that they revere him, the king.

entries.mt: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ
entries.note: על גז is unintelligible; leg. על גן 'auf Gärten' (Krochmal). And זרזיף is a suspicious hapax legomenon; leg. ירעיפו 'so die Erde befruchten' (Krochmal).
Leg. צדק 'Es blühe in seinen Tagen das Recht' (so also Krochmal).
Leg. צרים 'Gegner': 'Vor ihm mögen Gegner knieen'.
One cannot possibly say אביון twice in one verse (יחס על דל ואביון ... אביונים); at the close wohl leg. עניים or ענוים — 'das Leben der Sanftmüthigen retten'.

entries.emendation: pluralize all the verbs (וִיחְיוּ וְיִתְּנוּ לָמוֹ ...)
entries.note: The singulars are unintelligible if the reference is to the poor, who figure in the plural before. LXX have plural ויתפללו and יברכוהו; accordingly all the verbs must be pluralized: 'Sie werden aufleben ... und sie werden für ihn beten beständig'.
פסת is inexplicable; leg. שפעת (ס and פ interchanged, o. S. 134, and ש dropped): 'Möge Fülle des Kornes im Lande sein'. From v.16 begins the prayer promised by the sufferers.
'Zittern, rauschen' of grain? He reads a verb of abounding: 'auf Bergesspitzen möge reich sein wie im Libanon die Frucht'.
entries.flag: proposed verb garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Unintelligible — what is the plural subject? Leg. ערים (cf. Isa 25:2 מעיר לגל): 'aufblühen Städte wie Gras des Feldes'.
ינין/ינון is no word; LXX διαμενεῖ, i.e. יכון: 'Angesichts der Sonne aufgerichtet sein Name'.
To ויתברכו בו LXX have the addition πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς = כל עמי הארץ: 'sich mit ihm segnen alle Völker der Erde'.
LXX οἱ ὕμνοι, i.e. תהלות, 'was viel richtiger ist' (cf. o. S. 100): 'Zu Ende sind die Lobgesänge Davids'.

entries.mt: אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב
entries.emendation: אך טוב לְיָשָׁר אֵל / אלהים לברי לבב
entries.note: As it stands neither symmetrical nor clear; redivide לישראל into לישר אל (Ewald, Schorr): 'gütig für die Aufrichtigen ist Gott, für die Herzenslautern'.

entries.mt: נטוי (קרי נָטָיוּ) רַגְלָי ... שפכה (קרי שֻׁפְּכוּ) אֲשֻׁרָי
entries.note: נטיו רגלי cannot be right — the mere inclining of the foot does not yet entail the fall; and 'ausschütten den Schritt' is suspect: leg. a form of שמט 'glitten aus' (o. S. 132).
entries.flag: his replacement for נטיו garbled in OCR — verify

entries.mt: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם
entries.note: חרצבות (elsewhere only Isa 58:6, etymologically dark) cannot have the same sense in both places; here leg. עצבות 'Betrübniss' (Targum ומצטערין). The sequel was already emended by predecessors: למו תם ובריא אולם statt למותם — 'ungebrochen und gesund ist ihre Kraft' (against Hupfeld).
Likewise cannot be correct (cf. his note at Ps 59:14 on אינמו).
entries.flag: proposed reading garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: LXX plural περιεβάλοντο, Pesch. likewise: leg. יעטפו; שית means 'Gewand' (Prov 7:10 שית זונה): 'sie hüllen sich in das Gewand der Gewaltthat'.

Extraordinarily dark. עינמו can only be עונמו 'their guilt' (LXX ἀδικία, Pesch.); the verb Symmachus read as plural, so יצאו; and statt מחלב only מלב or מקרב can be read — cf. Hos 8:10(?), Isa 59:13 הרו והגו מלב דברי שקר: 'Sie ziehen aus dem Innern ihre Schuld'.

Pesch. renders משכיות by 'designs', i.e. מזמות (divined by Olshausen); עברו here means 'to be full, teeming' (Job 21:10, Josh 5:11-12 מעבור הארץ, perhaps Jer 5:28 עברו דברי רע): 'sie sind voll von Anschlägen des Herzens'.

ימיקו is inexplicable; leg. יעמיקו as the contrast of ממרום ('Vertieft sprechen sie vom Bösen'). And עשק is unintelligible; leg. עתק — the phrase דבר עתק is frequent (Ps 94:4): 'Trotz von der Höhe sprechen sie'.
תהלך is an abstruse form; leg. תהלל (cf. v.8's הוללים at Ps 73:3): 'ihre Zunge höhnt auf Erden'.

Riddling — a radical correction is needed. LXX and Pesch. read עמי 'my people, my circle'; statt ישוב leg. יתאו, and statt הלם leg. שלום/שלומם: 'darum begehrt mein Volk ihr Glück' (envies them their prosperity).
Must be symmetrical with the first half; restored by reading מְלֹא 'Fülle' statt מָלֵא. ימצו is in any case an incorrect form — either from מצה or ימצו from מצץ 'einschlürfen'.
ושלוי עולם is unintelligible — it cannot be the predicate, which lies in השגו חיל; leg. the verb ישליו, with עולם also emended.
entries.flag: his replacement for עולם garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Not symmetrical to ואהי נגוע; leg. per Symmachus (ἐλεγχόμενος) the Hophal: 'und werde gezüchtigt jeden Morgen'.

Unintelligible. Pesch. and Targum render כמו by 'like them', i.e. כמוהם, the syllable הם absorbed by the following הנה (which LXX and Aquila secure with ἰδού). And אספרה cannot be right — those introduced as speaking did not 'narrate' but reasoned; leg. אדברה. Nor is אם right (it cannot be a condition): leg. גם — 'Schon sprach auch ich, dass ich der Menge gleich reden will'.

Here too a radical cure: בניך and פניך are interchangeable (o. S. 121), so read הדר פניך (the ה absorbed from הנה), and statt בגדתי leg. כחדתי (interchanges of ב/כ and ג/ח): 'den Glanz Deines Antlitzes hätte ich verleugnet'.
עמל היא is unintelligible; leg. עמק (cf. Job 11:8, Koh 7:24 עמק עמק מי ימצאנו) — a parenthesis: 'schien tief in meinen Augen'.

עד here can only mean 'ehe', priusquam (Gen 48:5, Exod 22:25, 2 Sam 17:22, Ezek 33:22, Cant.); LXX and Pesch. have the singular ἁγιαστήριον: 'ehe ich in den Tempel eingehe' — whose rebuilding is awaited (a mark of the exilic date).

The verbs are incongruent; per LXX ἔθου read שת (the dittographed ת of חלקות made תשית of it) or שוית. And per v.19 (איך היו לשמה) the opening must likewise read איך (so Pesch.) statt אך: 'Wie hast Du sie auf schlüpfrige Glätte gesetzt'. The psalmist anticipates his wishes as accomplished fact.
The form למשואות is unusual and its etymology not quite certain; leg. לשוחות 'in Gruben' (cf. Ps 57:7).
The versions read מקיץ (LXX, Symmachus ἐξυπνισθέντος, Pesch.); if הקיץ is kept, one must read בהקיץ: 'Wie ein Traum beim Erwachen'. בעיר — LXX ἐν τῇ πόλει σου, in Zion; צלמם remains dark.
Unintelligible; read a verb 'erglühen' (interchange of צ and ם): 'Als sich mein Herz ereiferte'.
entries.flag: proposed form garbled in OCR (יחם? תחמם?) — verify

entries.note: Not quite correct; leg. אשתומם with כליותי as accusativus respectivus, or outright the plural השתוממו, the ו absorbed from ואני (v.22).

Dark — the Greek rendering κτηνώδης is happy, but the Hebrew is without analogy and in the plural to boot! Wohl read 'ermangelte der Einsicht bei Dir' via multiple letter-interchanges; parallel Ps 92:7.
entries.flag: exact reconstruction garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: Unintelligible; the כ of כבוד is to be drawn to ואחר, and the remaining letters read as 'by the hand' — 'und Dir nach nimm mich an der Hand' (vielleicht with תאחזני).
Supplying זולתך is awkward; Bruston's proposal is not proper Hebrew; he inclines to another short reading (his translation: 'Meine Macht ist mir im Himmel'). To ועמך לא חפצתי supply מאומה.
entries.flag: his preferred reading garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: After כלה שארי ולבבי the second לבבי is dittographed; leg. צורי וחלקי: 'mein Fels und mein Antheil ist Gott für immer'.

רחקיך is incorrect in form. Since יאבדו is future, הצמתה must also be future: leg. והצמתה, the ו absorbed by יאבדו; and כל זונה is to be taken as plural (o. S. 130): 'Du wirst hemmen alle, so von Dir abfallen'.

entries.emendation: divide: ואני קרבת אלהים לי / טוב שתי בה' מחסי
entries.note: Although the Masoretes indicated the right division by the accents, the interpreters draw טוב to a., where it is incongruent with קרבת: 'Mir aber ist Gottes Nähe; gut, dass ich in Gott meine Zuflucht gesetzt'.
LXX add ἐν ταῖς πύλαις τῆς θυγατρὸς Σιών = בשערי בת ציון, missing in the Hebrew text — the psalmist hopes to reach Zion, as he intimated in v.17 (cf. Pss 9:15, 102:22).
פעמיך 'feet' is secured (Symmachus), but one cannot say הרים רגל as one says הרים יד; wohl read a verb of hastening: 'Beschleunige Deine Schritte'.
entries.flag: proposed verb garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Cannot mean 'ewige Verwüstungen', of which nothing follows — the complaint is only of the foe's din and roaring (v.23 קול צרריך שאון קמיך); leg. לתשאות 'Geräusch': 'wider das andauernde Tosen'.

הרע cannot mean 'maltreat' (used only of persons, with dative); it must mean 'ertönen lassen', hence leg. קול statt כל (or even הרים קול); and for בקדש LXX have ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις σου = במקדשיך: 'laut lärmt der Feind in Deinem Heiligthum'.
Not properly intelligible; אותות can only be 'Wahrzeichen' (not idols); vielleicht another reading — 'geben ihre Zeichen als Wahrzeichen aus'.
entries.flag: his proposal garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Völlig unverständlich — only emendation helps. Targum's 'zerschlagen' read differently; rather leg. יריע (the roaring continues) and, for the dark כמביא למעלה, כמניף (interchanges, o. S. 130): 'Sie lärmen wie beim Hochschwingen der Beile am Baumgestrüppe' (קרדמות בסבך עץ).

All old versions except Targum have θύρας, i.e. פתחיה 'die Pforten' (also Rashi). ועת LXX and Pesch. curiously render as a verb ('they hewed down' — did they read גדעו?); Symmachus νῦν δέ. כשיל is Neo-Hebrew/Aramaic 'axe', כילפות Aramaic 'pick' — vielleicht leg. בכולבות.

Stands for שלחו אש במקדשך, since vv.3 and 7b presuppose the Temple still standing — fire was laid at the Temple gates in the time of Antiochus Epiphanes (1 Macc 4:38); לארץ חללו means profane, not destroy (לארץ = לעפר).

נינם is explicable neither as verb nor as substantive; Pesch. points to another reading. And for שרפו LXX's κατακαύσωμεν is surely a corruptel of the Sexta's καταπαύσωμεν — both render a verb 'let us make cease' rather than 'burn'.
entries.flag: the readings he adopts garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: כלה is unintelligible; LXX's εἰς τέλος is the Sexta's constant rendering of סלה, which seems to have entered the LXX text from there — סלה must be the right reading, fitting since a new train of thought begins with v.12: למה תשיב ידך וימינך מקרב חיקך סלה.
Cannot be apposition; LXX λαοῖς τοῖς Αἰθίοψιν. Vielleicht leg. לעם לובים 'dem Volke der Lybier'.
Leg. למות or לשחת: 'Gieb nicht dem Tode preis die Seele Deiner Taube'.
LXX 'Thy covenant': the ך dropped before the following כ of כי. 'Dein Bündniss' here appears to mean the religion, Judaism, as in Daniel 11 (ברית קדש).

Dark as it stands: ארץ can only be object of מלאו, whose subject is to be read מחשיכים 'die Dunkelmachenden, Unglückbringenden' (cf. Jer 13:16), with נאות חמס as second accusative (as Ezek 8:17 מלאו את הארץ חמס).

LXX and Pesch.: leg. וקראי שמך — under 'those who call on the Lord's name' the Levites are meant (cf. Ps 99:6), who have praised (ספרו perfect) God's deeds after a deliverance just celebrated in the Temple.

אקח מועד is inexplicable; leg. אקרא מועד — the classical expression for summoning an assembly for judgment (קרא מועד, קרואי מועד): 'Wenn ich die Versammlung zusammenrufe, werde ich in Geradheit richten'. Vv.3-4 are placed in God's mouth.

תכנתי is surely incorrect — תכן means 'zählen' and תקן is late Hebrew; read a verb 'befestigen': though earth and dwellers melt, God holds its pillars firm (supply בל תמוט; cf. Pss 82:5, 93:1, 96:10).
entries.flag: proposed form garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Durchaus unverständlich; the parallel Job 15:26 is itself corrupt (as Job 16:14 shows). LXX κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ show בצואר to be a strong corruptel of באדני or באביר (interchange of צ and א): 'sprechet nicht vom Herrn mit Trotz'.
Leg. ממדבר והרים — the southern steppe of Judah and the Lebanon mountains in the north; supply יצא משפט (as Ps 17:2): judgment comes from no quarter of the compass but from God.

מסך = the wine-jug (Isa 65:11, Prov 23:30): in God's hand are cup and jug. LXX ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο, likewise Pesch.: leg. מזה אל זה 'Er giesset von diesem in jenen'; but the dregs remain for the wicked.
אגיד is out of place; LXX ἀγαλλιάσομαι = אגיל (interchange of ד and ל, o. S. 127): 'Ich aber werde mich für immer freuen'.
אגדע — who speaks that? Read another person ('wirst Du zerbrechen'); and statt צדיק leg. plural צדיקים, per Pesch.
entries.flag: person of the emended verb garbled in OCR — verify

entries.note: Leg. בירושלם (frequent confusion of ישראל and ירושלם; cf. Monatschrift 1880, S. 97): 'in Jerusalem ist gross Sein Name', parallel to 'kund in Juda'.

שלם is another form of שילה (properly שלון/שלום — LXX often render שילה by Σαλήμ): in Shiloh God had only a hut, a tent (Ps 78:60), but in Zion a fixed dwelling, the Temple (מעונה): 'In Silo war Sein Zelt, Seine feste Stätte aber in Zion'.

The closing סלה is suspect — the parallelism is incomplete, and one cannot say שבר מלחמה; reading כלה statt סלה (cf. at Ps 55:20), b. answers a. perfectly: 'Schild und Schwert und Kriegswehr hat Er vernichtet'. שמה is temporal, not local (Sennacherib's army perished at Pelusium, not by Jerusalem).
Theodotion φοβερὸς εἶ = נורא, as below v.8 ('Furchtbar bist Du'); and statt טרף leg. אלף 'Rinderberge' (cf. his emendation at Ps 68:16): 'mächtiger als Rinderberge'.
Incongruent; LXX ἐπιβεβηκότες τοὺς ἵππους, likewise Pesch.: 'entschlummerten Rossesreiter'.
The first אתה is to be emended to עתה: 'Jetzt hast Du Dich furchtbar erwiesen'.
מאז is Widersinn; leg. מעז (as Ps 90:11): 'wer könnte vor Dir bei Deines Zornes Macht bestehen?'
'Feared and was still' contradict each other; leg. ושקעה, as Amos 9:5 (הנוגע בארץ ... ושקעה): 'die Erde erschrak und sank'.

entries.mt: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר
entries.note: Inexplicable as it stands. Leg. כי חמת ארם תודך, שארית חמת תחרג (from חרג 'zittern', o. S. 215): even Hamath will acknowledge God, for the remnant left it (after Tiglath-Pileser's deportations, 2 Kgs 16:9) will tremble — cf. Zech 9:2, where Hamath is to confess the God of Israel.

כל סביביו belongs to a. as vocative, and statt יובילו read the congruent imperative הובילו. And למורא is inexplicable even reading τῷ φοβερῷ with the versions; wohl leg. למרום (interchange of א and ם, o. S. 130), supplying למרום ציון, as Isa 18:7 (יובל שי ... אל מקום ... הר ציון).
